correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts all shapes with Omega at most two. The prime-square case reduces exactly to (p^2+p+1)|(p-3). The even semiprime case is impossible modulo q+1. In the odd semiprime case, divisibility by each sigma factor forces both primes to be 1 modulo 4, after which a 2-adic valuation contradiction is immediate.
risks: The finite replay cannot prove the infinite theorem; correctness rests on the symbolic case split.
